name: Polda 5.5
storyline:
The fifth installment of Polda, this classic point-and-click adventure game, ended with Detective Pankrác becoming a pharaoh. However, in the sixth installment, he was right back in Lupany. How could this happen? Why does he barely remember anything? And does the sixth part even follow the fifth? Are time anomalies, Professor Santusov, or someone else entirely to blame? If these questions have been troubling you, wonder no more. "Polda 5.5" brings another thrilling story packed with its signature humor, where you will discover the truth for yourself.

Pharaoh Pankrác, once again voiced by the brilliant Luděk Sobota, expects nothing from his subjects, but offers them nothing in return either. His days consist of only three activities: sleeping, lounging, and rehearsing the play Rambousek. You might ask yourself, what could possibly go wrong? Well, very soon, absolutely everything. Old rivals don't forget. And if there's one thing Pankrác excels at, it's making enemies.

Let's return to the places where we left our hero Pankrác twenty years ago.
summary: Polda 5.5 is a comedic point-and-click adventure game featuring full Czech voice acting, stylized environments, and classic inventory-based puzzle solving. Players control three distinct characters across dozens of locations to uncover what happened during Pankrác's time as a pharaoh.
